metadata.description: Account management skills for B2B service companies: client health scoring, upsell mapping, case study production.

plugins.name: account-management-engine
plugins.description: 5 Claude Code skills for the retention & growth block of a GTM system for B2B service companies: client health check (6-criteria green/yellow/red scoring with action plans), upsell mapper (client x services cross-sell matrix with prioritized entry moves), case study writer (project -> publishable case in the 12-section Case Study Kit structure, 3 output formats), account dossier (one target company -> signal stack, ICP fit, decision-maker pair, two-pass lead score and first-touch drafts in the prospect's language), and customer intelligence (your own case studies + reviews -> pains, triggers, customer language, competitive positioning). Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
